note: Glaze 1.0.24: the theme art widgets are now Artwork 1 to Artwork 5, small only, each with its own colour (coral, amber, mint, blue, violet). The gallery shows each colour with a big number, and My widget art shows the same badge on the matching piece. On the Home Screen each shows your current theme's artwork in that position; a theme with fewer pieces repeats them, so none is ever blank.
